description:
Somebody has to sit the post while somebody else sleeps.

The Blind looks down the length of the wash. The shortwave mutters to itself on a frequency nobody has ever answered. The whole of the job is that you are there, and awake, and that if the thing the Watch have been waiting eleven years for comes down that wash tonight, one person sees it.

Pike will not thank you. Pike has sat it ten thousand times and has never once been thanked either.
name: A Turn on the Blind

objectives.desc: Sit the post at the Blind. Do not open the door.
emotes: {who} watches the mirror down the length of the wash, and nothing comes.
{who} listens to the shortwave mutter, and nothing in it is for them.
{who} shifts once on the stool and settles again.
{who} thinks about how much of a life this adds up to, and then stops thinking about it.
